name: FIFA
description: The global governing body for national team football, organizing the World Cup and its regional qualifiers.

name: UEFA
description: Europe's governing body, running both the men's and women's national team championships and the continent's top club competitions.

name: CONMEBOL
description: South America's confederation, organizing the Copa América for national teams and the Copa Libertadores for clubs.

name: Premier League
description: The top flight of English club football.
